referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include energy consumption, transport and infrastructure related to the processing of bast fibres to yarn (opening, batching, cardening, spinning).
referenceFunction.name: Yarn production, bast fibres

technology.text: Opening, batching, cardening, combing and spinning are the main processes of the yarn production. Mechanical cleaning and no chemical cleaning was assumed for this study.

representativeness.extrapolations: Infrastructure of mechanical processings of fibres was assumed similar to packaging plant
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data are from expert interviews and literature.
